title: LinkedIn Public Profile Scraper
description: Scrape publicly accessible LinkedIn profile information and/or posts from one or more profile URLs.

startUrls.title: LinkedIn profile URLs
startUrls.description: LinkedIn public profile URLs to scrape. Up to 100 unique URLs per run.

maxProfiles.title: Maximum profiles
maxProfiles.description: Maximum number of profiles to process from the URL list.

onlyProfileInfo.title: Profile information only
onlyProfileInfo.description: Return one structured profile record per URL and do not scrape posts.

maxItems.title: Maximum posts per profile
maxItems.description: Maximum number of posts to return for each profile when Profile information only is disabled.

onlyPostsNewerThan.title: Only posts newer than
onlyPostsNewerThan.description: Optional ISO/date filter for posts. Only used when post scraping is enabled.

includeProfileInfo.title: Include profile information with posts
includeProfileInfo.description: Include profile fields in each post record when post scraping is enabled.

useProxyOnlyAfterFail.title: Use proxy only after failure
useProxyOnlyAfterFail.description: Retry failed requests with the configured proxy.

maxProxiedRetries.title: Maximum proxied retries
maxProxiedRetries.description: Maximum retries after switching to the configured proxy.

maxRequestRetries.title: Request retries
maxRequestRetries.description: Retries before a request is considered failed.

maxConcurrency.title: Concurrency
maxConcurrency.description: Number of profiles processed simultaneously. Lower values can improve reliability.

disableImagesStylesFonts.title: Block images, styles and fonts
disableImagesStylesFonts.description: Reduces bandwidth and memory usage during scraping.
